note: Both sets capture the core torque-saturation, rate-limit, rated-speed and single-DOF facts, and both contain duplicate claims (47,402.91 N•m, 1173.7 rpm, the regulation goal). Set A adds the useful speed-error control-input claim that B omits, but it also adds two figure-derived claims whose quotes are only the figure caption: the 0 N•m at 0 rpm point is unsupported by the quote, and 50,000 N•m at ~1,400 rpm misreads the blue variable-speed curve (which is ~36,000 N•m there; 50,000 is the axis top/black curve). Set B's only figure claim (50,000 N•m at ~1,200 rpm) is likewise a misread of the blue curve peak (~43,000 N•m), but B otherwise keeps needed conditions better (the high intrinsic drivetrain damping as the reason for omitting the torsional-damping loop) and adds that damping fact explicitly. Net, B has fewer wrong claims while retaining the key conditions, so it is slightly better.
